title: Incorrect
slide_intent: Learn to recognize image treatments that obscure the food, remove its physical context or make a moment feel posed. Comparing named faults makes feedback more precise.
strategic_value: Instacart can give photographers and editors a shared way to reject images that weaken appetite or credibility.
demonstration: A white field holds rows of rejected photographs with red crosses and captions. Examples address staging, isolation, filtering, exposure, depth of field and glossy reflections.
practical_value: Identify the visible fault in a candidate image and give the photographer a specific correction, such as reducing glare or moving the food into the focal plane.

content_islands.name: Page heading
content_islands.spec: Place Incorrect in the open upper-left position so the reader knows how to interpret every example.

content_islands.name: Rejected image grid
content_islands.spec: Set the photographs at a common landscape size across a staggered four-column grid. Attach a red cross and the reason for rejection to each image, including the bananas with the reflected silhouette.
